bio: Located on the edge of the Old Town, this charming little bistro is decorated with vintage French posters and photographs of famous actors. It’s a resolutely classic setting for an unashamedly traditional and proudly French restaurant, where the menu offers the likes of frog’s legs, duck confit, cordon bleu and crêpes Suzette to finish. This hearty cooking combines perfectly with friendly service to create a warm and comforting experience.
